title: carex × fulva var. subsalsa

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
